how_to_use: Keep your 8 questions from Project 16 and add the new ones below.
'kind' says which retriever SHOULD win - that is the point of the case.
Fill 'expected_source' yourself from your own docs: the file (and chunk) that really contains the answer.
A case only teaches you something if you know the right answer before you run it.

field_meaning.kind: semantic = only dense can find it | keyword = only BM25 can find it | both = control case | neither = known miss
field_meaning.expected_source: the source file that must appear in the top 4
field_meaning.why: what this case is testing - write it, do not skip it

cases.question: How much vacation do I get after a production incident?
cases.expected_source: TODO - the file with 'time off in lieu when paged'
cases.why: The Project 16 failure. Question wording and document wording share nothing except 'production'. Dense missed it at top_k=6. Does BM25 find it through the word 'incident'? Does fusion pull it into the top 4?

cases.question: TODO - ask about something using an EXACT rare term from your docs (a tool name, an acronym, a version number, a policy name)
cases.why: Exact rare tokens are what BM25 is for. Dense embeddings blur them. This case should fail on dense and pass on sparse.

cases.question: TODO - take a sentence straight out of one of your docs and rewrite it with completely different words
cases.why: The mirror of case 2. Should pass on dense and fail on sparse. If it passes on both, the rewrite was not aggressive enough.

cases.question: TODO - a plain, obvious question your current pipeline already answers correctly
cases.why: Control case. Hybrid must not make an already-working question worse. This is the regression you are most likely to cause.

cases.question: TODO - a question containing a common word that appears in EVERY document (for example 'team' or 'policy')
cases.why: Tests IDF. A word present everywhere should carry almost no BM25 weight. If this case gets noticeably worse, look at your tokenizer and at stopwords.

cases.question: TODO - something none of your documents cover
cases.why: BM25 always returns k results, however bad they are - it has no concept of 'no match'. Check that the grounded prompt still answers 'I don't know' and that used_sources comes back empty.

comparison_table.note: Also try alpha 0.0 and 1.0 as a sanity check: alpha=1.0 must reproduce dense_only exactly, alpha=0.0 must reproduce bm25_only. If it does not, your normalization or your missing-value default is wrong.
